description: This source file defines a ShellExecutor utility using Swift's asynchronous features to run shell commands, capture outputs, and handle timeouts. It includes a nested struct for command results, methods to execute commands with detailed result handling, and proper process management.

classes.name: ShellExecutor
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to execute shell commands asynchronously, capturing output and handling timeouts.

classes.name: ShellExecutor.ShellResult
classes.description: A struct representing the outcome of executing a shell command, including output streams, exit status, timeout status, success flag, and error message.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously with detailed output, timeout, and environment configuration, returning a ShellResult.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Convenience method that calls runDetailed and returns a Response object with success status, message, and payload.
